吸引附近敌人的仇恨
wiki_description: Spawns a fly familiar that moves in a straight line and circles around the first wall or obstacle it hits. Category:Modified in Repentance It deals 105 damage per second on contact. Category:Modified in Repentance It deals 56 damage per second and forces nearby enemies to attack it.

name: Scatter Bombs
quote: We put bombs in your bombs!
description_en:
+5 Bombs
Isaac's bombs scatter into 4-5 tiny bombs
description_zh:
+5炸弹
角色的炸弹会炸成4-5个小炸弹
wiki_description: +5 Bombs. Isaac's bombs explode into 2-4 tiny bombs.

name: Sticky Bombs
description_en:
+5 Bombs
 Isaac's bombs stick to enemies and leave white slowing creep
Killing an enemy with a bomb spawns blue spiders
description_zh:
+5炸弹
 角色的炸弹会粘在敌人身上并留下减速水迹
用炸弹击杀敌人会生成蓝蜘蛛
wiki_description: +5 Bombs. Bombs stick to enemies and spawn 2-5 Blue Spiders on kill. Category:Modified in Repentance Bombs leave a long-lasting puddle of slowing creep. Category:Modified in Repentance+ Spawns 1-2 Blue Spiders or Blue Flies when bombs damage enemies.

name: Epiphora
description_en: Shooting in one direction gradually increases fire rate up to 200% and decreases accuracy
description_zh: 持续向单方向发射会逐渐提高射速修正至200%并降低射击精度
wiki_description: Shooting in one direction increases Isaac's rate of fire until the cap is reached. As soon as Isaac changes direction or stops shooting, rate of fire is reset to its normal amount.

name: Continuum
description_en:
+3 Range
Spectral tears
Tears can travel through one side of the screen and come out the other side
description_zh:
射程+3
灵体泪弹
泪弹可以飞出屏幕一侧, 并从另一侧回来
wiki_description: Grants spectral tears and increases range. Tears travel through walls and appear at the opposite side of the room.

name: Mr. Dolly
description_en:
+0.7 Tears
 +2.5 Range
 Spawns 3 random hearts
description_zh:
+0.7射速
 +2.5射程
 拾起时生成3随机心
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance +0.7 tears, +5.25 range, +0.5 tear falling speed, Spawns a combination of 3 Red Hearts, Soul Hearts or Black Hearts on the floor when picked up. Category:Modified in Repentance +0.7 tears, +2.5 range, spawns 3 random types of Hearts on the floor when picked up.

name: Curse of the Tower
description_en:
Taking damage spawns 6 Troll Bombs
The Troll Bombs inherit Isaac's bomb effects
description_zh:
受伤时, 生成6个即爆炸弹
该炸弹继承角色的炸弹效果
wiki_description: Upon taking damage, spawns six Troll Bombs around the room, similar to the effect of XVI - The Tower .

name: Charged Baby
description_en:
Every 30 seconds while in an uncleared room, the familiar can:
 Spawn a Battery (max 2 per room)
 Add one charge to the active item (max 2 per room)
 Petrify all enemies in the room
description_zh:
在未清理的房间中, 每30秒产生以下效果之一:
 生成1电池(每房间最多2次)
 为主动道具充能1格(每房间最多2次)
 将房间中所有敌人石化
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that occasionally drops a Lil' Battery, gives an active item charge, or petrifies all enemies in the room.

name: Dead Eye
description_en:
Consecutive tear hits on enemies grant +25% damage (max +100%)
Missing has a chance to reset the multiplier
description_zh:
每次成功击中敌人伤害+25%(最高+100%)
未击中时, 概率重置修正
wiki_description: Isaac's damage increases each time an enemy is hit. Damage is reset upon missing a shot.

name: Holy Light
description_en:
10% chance to shoot holy tears, which spawn a beam of light on hit
 50% chance at 9 luck
 The beams deals 3x Isaac's damage
description_zh:
10%概率发射圣光泪弹, 击中时会产生光柱
 幸运9: 50%概率
 光柱造成3x角色伤害
wiki_description: Adds a chance to fire holy tears, which will create a damaging light beam in the area if they hit an enemy.

name: Host Hat
description_en:
Grants immunity to explosions and falling projectiles
20% chance to reflect enemy shots
description_zh:
免疫爆炸和掉落弹幕
20%概率反弹敌人弹幕
wiki_description: A host familiar that sits on Isaac's head and has a 20% chance to block enemy shots and retaliate with 3 tears. Grants immunity to explosions.

name: Restock
description_en:
Buying an item from a Shop restocks it instantly
Restocked items increase in price each time
description_zh:
商店物品购买后会立刻补货
每次补货价格都会提高
wiki_description: Causes Shops to instantly restock their items when they are bought. Category:Modified in Repentance Outside of Greed Mode, the restocked item's cost is increased after each purchase.

name: Bursting Sack
description_en: Spider enemies no longer target or deal contact damage to Isaac
description_zh: 蜘蛛类敌人不再以角色为目标, 也不对角色造成接触伤害
wiki_description: Spider enemies no longer target or deal contact damage to Isaac.

name: No. 2
description_en: Holding a fire button for 2.35 seconds spawns a lit Butt Bomb
description_zh: 持续发射2.35秒后, 生成1大便炸弹
wiki_description: Continuously firing tears for 2.35 seconds causes Isaac to drop a Butt Bombs bomb, which damages and confuses all enemies in the room when it explodes.

name: Pupula Duplex
description_en:
x2 Tear size
Spectral tears
description_zh:
泪弹尺寸x2
灵体泪弹
wiki_description: Gives Isaac spectral tears and gives his tears a wide arc shape, increasing their size.

name: Pay To Play
description_en:
+5 Coins
Locked blocks, doors and chests must be opened with coins instead of keys
description_zh:
+5硬币
 钥匙方块, 门和箱子必须用硬币打开而不是钥匙
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance +5 Coins. Most doors require one Penny to open instead of a Key. Category:Modified in Repentance +5 Coins. All locked doors, Locked Chests, and Key Blocks must be opened with one Penny instead of Keys.

name: Eden's Blessing
description_en:
+0.7 Tears
Grants a random item at the start of the next run
description_zh:
射速+0.7
下一局开始时, 获得1随机道具
wiki_description: +0.7 tears up. Grants a random item at the start of the next run.

name: Friendly Ball
description_en:
Can be thrown at enemies to capture them
 Using the item after capturing an enemy spawns the capture as a friendly companion
Walking over the ball after a capture instantly recharges the item
description_zh:
可以扔向敌人将其捕捉
 成功捕捉后，下一次使用则会生成相同的友好敌人
靠近捕捉后的球会立即将道具充能
wiki_description: Throwing the ball at a monster instantly kills and captures it. The captured enemy can later be released and will be friendly, fighting for Isaac and persisting between rooms.

name: Tear Detonator
description_en: Splits all of Isaac's tears currently on screen in a circle of 6 tears
description_zh: 引爆屏幕中的泪弹, 每颗泪弹分裂为6颗并以环状散开
wiki_description: Splits all of Isaac's tears that are currently in the air into 6 tears that fire in all directions, which retain their damage and shot speed.

name: Lil Gurdy
description_en:
Launches and bounces around the room with speed based on charge amount
Deals 5-20 contact damage per hit depending on speed
description_zh:
弹出并在房间中反弹, 速度基于蓄力时间
根据其速度, 每次击中造成5-20点接触伤害
wiki_description: A Gurdy Jr. familiar that charges up while Isaac is firing, bouncing around the room when released and dealing contact damage based on its speed.

name: Bumbo
description_en:
Picks up nearby coins
Levels up after getting 6, 12, and 24 coins
Lv2: Chance to spawn item after room clears
Lv3: Shoots tears that can spawn coins on hit
Lv4: Chases enemies, occasionally dropping bombs, can spawn item on coin pickup
description_zh:
捡起附近的硬币
捡起6, 12, 24硬币时升级
2级: 清理房间后, 概率生成掉落物或道具
3级: 发射泪弹, 击中时概率生成硬币
4级: 追击敌人, 每秒造成37.5点接触伤害
4级: 继续捡硬币, 能生成掉落物或道具
wiki_description: Spawns a beggar familiar which picks up any nearby coins, leveling up after collecting several coins. At level 2, Bumbo gains a body. At level 3, it begins to fire tears. At level 4, Bumbo follows enemies and gains contact damage.

name: D12
description_en:
Rerolls any obstacle into another random obstacle (e.g. poop, pots, TNT, red poop, stone blocks etc.)
Small chance to reroll obstacles into buttons, killswitches, crawlspaces or trapdoors
description_zh:
将障碍物重置为其他随机类型的障碍物(大便/罐子/TNT/红大便/石头等)
小概率重置为按钮/击杀按钮/暗门/活板门
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Re-rolls all Rocks and Metal Blocks in the current room into other random obstacles. Category:Modified in Repentance Re-rolls most types of obstacles in the current room into other random obstacles.

name: Censer
description_en: Familiar surrounded by a huge aura of light that slows down enemies and projectiles in it
description_zh: 被大片光环围绕的跟班, 能够使其中的敌人和弹幕减速
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar which creates a circular aura that slows down enemies and enemy shots inside.

name: Key Bum
description_en:
Picks up nearby keys
 Spawns random chests in return
description_zh:
捡起附近的钥匙
 生成随机箱子作为回报
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and collects Keys for himself, giving random Chests in return.

name: Rune Bag
description_en: Spawns a random rune or Soul Stone every 7-8 rooms
description_zh: 每7-8个房间生成1随机符文/魂石
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that drops a random rune after clearing enough rooms.

name: Seraphim
description_en:
Shoots Sacred Heart tears
Deals 10 damage per tear
description_zh:
发射圣心泪弹
泪弹造成10点伤害
wiki_description: Spawns an angel familiar who follows Isaac and fires homing tears which deal 10 damage and have 75% shot speed.

name: Betrayal
description_en: Enemies can hit each other with their projectiles, and start infighting
description_zh: 敌人弹幕会击中其他敌人, 并引起内讧
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Charms all enemies in the room when Isaac takes damage. Category:Modified in Repentance Enemies are able to damage each other. If an enemy is damaged by another enemy, they will attack that enemy instead of Isaac.

name: Zodiac
description_en: Grants a random zodiac item effect every floor
description_zh: 每层获得1个随机星座道具效果
wiki_description: Gives Isaac a random zodiac item effect that changes every floor.

name: Serpent's Kiss
description_en:
15% chance to shoot poison tears
 Poison enemies on contact
 Enemies killed by contact poison have a 20% chance to drop a Black Heart on death
description_zh:
15%概率发射有毒泪弹
 使接触的敌人中毒
 因接触而中毒的敌人死亡时, 20%概率掉落黑心
wiki_description: Tears have a chance to apply a poison effect to enemies. Isaac poisons enemies on contact. Poisoned enemies have a chance to drop a Black Heart when killed.

name: Marked
description_en:
+0.7 Tears
 +3 Range
Isaac automatically shoots tears at a movable red target on the ground
Familiars shoot towards the target too
You can stop shooting and reset the target's location by pressing the drop button ()
description_zh:
射速+0.7
 射程+3
角色自动向地上的可控红色标记发射泪弹
跟班也向标记发射
按掉落键()停止发射并重置标记位置
wiki_description: Isaac will automatically fire tears directed at a red target on the ground. The target can be moved with tear controls. +0.7 tears, increases range.

name: Tech X
description_en:
Isaac's tears are replaced by a chargeable laser ring
Ring size and damage increases up to 100% with charge time
description_zh:
角色的泪弹由可蓄力的激光环取代
激光环尺寸和伤害随蓄力时间增加, 最多增加至100%角色伤害
wiki_description: Tears are replaced with laser rings that pierce through enemies and deal damage to enemies within them. Can be charged to increase the effectiveness of the ring.

name: Ventricle Razor
description_en:
Creates up to two portals to travel between
Can be placed in different rooms
description_zh:
创造最多2个传送门
可以在不同房间放置
wiki_description: Creates up to two portals that remain even if Isaac leaves the room. Upon entering a portal, Isaac is teleported to the other portal.

name: Tractor Beam
description_en:
+1 Fire rate
 +2.5 Range
 +0.16 Shot speed
Isaac's tears always travel along a beam of light in front of him
description_zh:
射速修正+1
 射程+2.5
 弹速+0.16
角色的泪弹受角色面前的光束指引
wiki_description: Isaac's tears are bound to a beam emitting in the direction he's firing. Category:Modified in Repentance +0.5 Tears, +5.25 Range, +0.16 Shot Speed. Category:Modified in Repentance +1 Fire Rate, +2.5 Range, +0.16 Shot Speed.

name: God's Flesh
description_en:
Tears have a 20% chance to shrink enemies
Shrunken enemies can be crushed and killed by walking over them
description_zh:
20%概率发射使敌人缩小的泪弹
缩小的敌人可以被踩死
wiki_description: Tears have a chance to shrink enemies, making them run away from Isaac. Shrunk enemies can be crushed and killed by walking over them.

name: Maw of the Void
description_en:
Firing tears for 2.35 seconds and releasing the fire button creates a black brimstone ring around Isaac
It deals 30x Isaac's damage over 2 seconds
description_zh:
持续发射泪弹2.35秒后, 松开发射键会产生黑硫磺火圈
黑圈在2秒内造成30x角色伤害
wiki_description: While firing, Isaac can charge and unleash a black ring that rapidly deals damage around him. Category:Modified in Repentance The ring can cause enemies to drop Black Hearts. +1 damage.

name: Spear of Destiny
description_en:
Isaac holds a spear in front of him
 The spear deals twice his damage and can fear enemies on contact
description_zh:
在角色面前生成一根矛
 每秒造成约8.57x角色伤害, 概率使接触到的敌人恐惧
wiki_description: In addition to tears, Isaac holds a spear in front of him which deals contact damage equal to 2× his tear damage, and occasionally inflicts fear.

name: Explosivo
description_en:
25% chance to shoot sticky tears
Sticky tears grow and explode after a few seconds, dealing Isaac's damage +60
description_zh:
25%概率发射粘性泪弹
粘住的泪弹会变大并在几秒后爆炸, 造成1x角色伤害+60的伤害
wiki_description: Isaac's tears have a chance to stick to enemies and explode.

name: Chaos
description_en:
All items are chosen from random item pools
Spawns 1-6 random pickups
description_zh:
底座道具会从随机道具池产生
生成1-6随机掉落物
wiki_description: Drops 1-6 random pickups on the floor. Causes items to be chosen from random item pools.

name: Spider Mod
description_en:
Displays tear damage and health bars of all enemies
Inflicts random status effects to enemies on contact
Randomly spawns batteries or blue spiders
description_zh:
显示泪弹伤害和所有敌人的血条
接触敌人时, 施加随机状态效果
清理房间后, 概率生成蓝蜘蛛/小电池
wiki_description: Displays Isaac's tear damage and enemy health bars. Spawns a familiar that wanders around and inflicts random status effects on enemies it touches. Can spawn a Lil' Battery (Category:Modified in RepentanceMicro Battery) / Blue spider upon clearing a room.

name: Farting Baby
description_en:
Blocks projectiles
When hit, 10% chance to fart and charm, poison or knockback enemies
The farts deal 5-6 damage
description_zh:
阻挡弹幕
受击时, 10%概率放屁, 效果为魅惑/中毒/击退三种其一
屁造成5-6点伤害
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and blocks enemy shots. If a shot hits Farting Baby, it has a chance to fart, which charms, poisons, or knocks back nearby enemies.

name: GB Bug
description_en:
Throwable (double-tap shoot)
Rerolls enemies and pickups it comes in contact with
description_zh:
可投掷(双击发射键)
重置其接触到的敌人和掉落物
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Spawns a familiar that bounces diagonally around the room, applying a random status effect to enemies it hits and has a chance to re-roll pickups it passes over. Category:Modified in Repentance Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac. Double tapping the fire button launches it forward, causing it to reroll the first monster or pickup it hits.

name: D8
description_en:
Multiplies Isaac's damage, tears, range and speed stats by between x0.5 and x2
The multipliers are rerolled each use
description_zh:
角色的伤害, 射速, 射程, 移速属性的修正x0.5-x2
修正在每次使用后重置
wiki_description: Re-rolls Isaac's damage, tears, range, and speed.

name: Purity
description_en:
Boosts one of Isaac's stats depending on the color of the aura
Taking damage removes the effect, and grants a new effect in the next room
Yellow = +0.5 Speed
Blue = +2 Fire rate
Red = +4 Damage
Orange = +3 Range
description_zh:
根据光环颜色对角色属性进行增强
受伤时, 移除光环, 在下个房间获得新的光环
黄色 = 移速+0.5
蓝色 = 射速修正+2
红色 = 伤害+4
橙色 = 射程+3
wiki_description: Boosts one of Isaac's stats depending on the color of the aura around him. The aura disappears upon taking damage and reappears with a random color upon entering a new room. Red boosts damage, blue boosts tears, yellow boosts speed, and orange boosts range.

name: Athame
description_en:
25% chance for a black brimstone ring to spawn around killed enemies
It deals 30x Isaac's damage over 2 seconds
 +2.5% chance per luck
description_zh:
25%概率在被击杀敌人周围生成黑色硫磺火圈
黑圈2秒内造成30x角色伤害
 每点幸运+2.5%概率
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance When Isaac takes damage, a damaging black ring briefly appears around him. This ring can cause enemies to drop Black Hearts. Category:Modified in Repentance After Isaac kills an enemy, adds a luck-based chance to spawn a damaging black ring around them.

name: Empty Vessel
description_en:
+2 Black Hearts
 When Isaac has no Red Hearts:
Flight
Every 40 seconds while in a hostile room, gain a shield for 10 seconds
description_zh:
+2黑心
 角色没有红心时:
获得飞行
在有敌人的房间中, 每40秒产生1个持续10秒的护盾
wiki_description: Grants two Black Hearts. While Isaac has no red hearts, grants flight and periodically grants an invincibility shield for a few seconds.

name: Evil Eye
description_en:
3.33% chance to shoot an eye
 10% chance at 20 luck
The eye moves in a straight line and shoots tears in the same direction as Isaac
description_zh:
3.33%概率发射眼睛
 幸运20: 10%概率
眼睛缓慢移动并发射与角色方向一致的泪弹
wiki_description: Adds a chance to fire a slow-moving eye that fires tears in the same direction as Isaac. The eye is destroyed when it hits an enemy or obstacle.

name: Lusty Blood
description_en:
+0.5 Damage for each enemy killed in the room
Caps at +5 Damage after 10 kills
description_zh:
击杀敌人时, 在当前房间中伤害+0.5
最多击杀10个敌人伤害+5
wiki_description: Isaac's damage increases for the current room each time he kills an enemy.

name: Cambion Conception
description_en:
Taking damage 15 times spawns a permanent demon familiar
After two familiars, it takes 30 instead of 15
Caps at 4 familiars
description_zh:
受伤15次, 30次, 60次, 90次时, 永久获得1个恶魔跟班
最多产生4个跟班
wiki_description: After taking damage a certain amount of times, a permanent demonic familiar spawns.

name: Immaculate Conception
description_en:
Picking up 15 hearts spawns a permanent angelic familiar and a Soul Heart
Caps at 5 familiars
description_zh:
每拾起15次心, 永久获得1个天使跟班并生成1魂心
最多产生5个跟班
wiki_description: Upon picking up a certain amount of health, spawn a permanent angelic familiar.

name: More Options
description_en: Allows Isaac to choose between 2 items in treasure rooms
description_zh: 允许宝箱房道具二选一
wiki_description: Two item pedestals are presented in every Treasure Room. Only one can be taken; the other will disappear.

name: Crown Of Light
description_en:
+2 Soul Hearts
If Isaac has no damaged heart containers:
 x2 Damage multiplier
 -0.3 Shot speed
Taking any damage removes the effect for the room
description_zh:
+2魂心
若角色无不满的心之容器:
 伤害修正x2
 弹速-0.3
受伤后, 在当前房间中效果消失
wiki_description: +2 Soul Hearts. While Isaac has no empty red hearts, grants 2x damage, -0.3 shot speed, Category:Modified in Repentance and increased range. Regardless of health, the crown deactivates for the current room when Isaac takes damage.

name: Deep Pockets
description_en:
If clearing a room would yield no reward, spawns 1-3 coins
 Increases the coin cap to 999
description_zh:
若清理房间没有奖励, 则生成1-3硬币
 提高硬币上限至999
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Allows Isaac to carry two cards or pills (or a combination of both) at the same time. Category:Modified in Repentance Increases the coin cap to 999. If a room would otherwise yield no reward, 1-3 coins will spawn.

name: Succubus
description_en:
Bounces around the room surrounded by a damaging aura that deals 7.5-10 damage per second
 x1.5 Damage multiplier while standing in the aura
description_zh:
在房间中漂浮的跟班, 产生伤害光环, 每秒造成7.5-10点伤害
 站在光环中伤害修正x1.5
wiki_description: Spawns a flying familiar that bounces around the room with a black aura, dealing rapid damage to any enemies inside it. While standing in the aura, Isaac gains a 1.5× tear damage multiplier.

name: Fruit Cake
description_en: Each one of Isaac's tears gets a different effect
description_zh: 每颗泪弹都有不同效果
wiki_description: Isaac's tears gain a random effect that changes every shot.

name: Teleport 2.0
description_en:
Teleports Isaac to a room that has not been cleared yet
Hierarchy: >>>>>>>> >>>>>>>
description_zh:
传送至未探索的随机房间
等级: >>>>>>>> >>>>>>>
wiki_description: Teleports Isaac to a room that has not been explored yet. Normal rooms are prioritized over special rooms, and common special rooms take priority over rarer ones.

name: Black Powder
description_en:
Walking in a circle draws a pentagram on the floor, which deals 130 damage over 4 seconds
Grants bigger explosions
Fireplaces explode when extinguished
description_zh:
在地上走1个圈会产生五角星符号, 4秒内造成130点接触伤害
获得更大范围的爆炸效果
火堆熄灭时会爆炸
wiki_description: Isaac leaves a trail of black powder on the floor. Walking in a circle will spawn a pentagram symbol on the floor, which deals 10 damage per tick to any enemies inside it. Category:Modified in Repentance+ Grants larger explosions and fireplaces will explode when extinguished.

name: Kidney Bean
description_en: Charms all enemies in close range
description_zh: 魅惑近距离的所有敌人
wiki_description: Isaac farts, charming all nearby enemies.

name: Glowing Hourglass
description_en:
Brings Isaac back to the previous room and reverses all actions done in the room the item was used in
The rewind can be used three times per floor
 Acts as The Hourglass when out of rewinds, which slows enemies down for 8 seconds
description_zh:
将角色带回上个房间, 回退所有使用时房间的行动
每层仅可使用三次
 用尽次数后与沙漏作用一致, 即使敌人减速8秒

wiki_description: Transforms Isaac into another random character and has Category:Modified in AfterbirthCategory:Modified in Repentance+ 100% / Category:Modified in Repentance 50% chance to remove the last item collected.

name: Mama Mega!
description_en:
Affects the whole floor
Explodes all objects
Deals 200 damage to all enemies
Opens secret rooms
Opens Boss Rush and Hush regardless of time
description_zh:
影响整层
炸碎所有障碍物
对所有敌人造成200点伤害
打开隐藏房的门
无论时间, 打开头目车轮战和死寂的门
wiki_description: Deals immense damage to all enemies, opens all bombable doors, and destroys all obstacles in the room. The effect occurs every time a new room is entered for the rest of the floor.

name: Wait What?
quote: I can't believe it's not butter bean!
description_en:
Upon use, pushes enemies away and spawns a rock wave around Isaac
The rock wave can open rooms and break rocks
description_zh:
使用时, 推走敌人并生成岩石波
岩石波可以开门或摧毁石头
wiki_description: Isaac farts, sending out a circular rock wave that destroys obstacles and hurts enemies.

name: Crooked Penny
description_en:
50% chance to double all items, pickups and chests in room
50% chance to remove items / pickups in room and spawn 1 coin
description_zh:
50%概率使房间中所有道具, 掉落物和箱子翻倍
50%概率将上述内容移除并生成1硬币
wiki_description: Has a 50% chance to double all items, chests, trinkets, and pickups in the room. If the effect fails, spawns a Penny and the other items and pickups disappear.

name: Dull Razor
description_en:
Hurts Isaac without removing health
Triggers any on-hit item effects
description_zh:
使角色受伤但不掉血
触发'受伤时触发'道具的效果
wiki_description: Hurts Isaac without depleting health, activating any items that trigger upon taking damage.

name: Potato Peeler
description_en:
Removes 1 heart container for: 
 +0.2 Damage
 A Cube of Meat
 Receive for the room:
 +1.5 Range
 Leave a trail of blood creep
description_zh:
移除1心之容器, 获得:
 伤害+0.2
 肉块
 当前房间中获得:
 射程+1.5
 留下血迹
wiki_description: Removes a Heart Container, increases Damage and Range, and grants a Cube of Meat . Category:Modified in Repentance+ If Isaac has a Ball of Bandages , it will instead give additional copies of that.

name: Metronome
description_en: Grants a random item effect for the room
description_zh: 在当前房间中获得1个随机道具的效果
wiki_description: Grants a random item effect for the current room.

name: D Infinity
description_en:
Can be made to act as any die item (except Spindown Dice) with the drop button ()
Charge time varies based on the last die used and updates with every use
description_zh:
可以通过掉落键()更改为任意骰子道具(计数二十面骰除外)
充能条基于最后使用的骰子变化
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Has the effect of a random die item that changes each use. Category:Modified in Repentance Replicates the effect of a selected die item (except Spindown Dice), and can be cycled through by pressing the drop key.

name: Eden's Soul
description_en:
Spawns 2 random items depending on the current room's item pool
Starts with no charges
description_zh:
根据当前房间的道具池生成2个随机道具
起始无充能
wiki_description: Spawns two random items from the current room's Item Pool and then disappears. Starts with no charges.

name: Acid Baby
description_en:
Spawns a random pill every 7 rooms
 Using a pill poisons all enemies in the room
description_zh:
每7个房间生成1随机胶囊
 使用胶囊会使房间中所有敌人中毒
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that drops a random pill every Category:Modified in Repentance 3 / Category:Modified in Repentance 7 rooms. Upon using a pill, all enemies in the room are poisoned.

name: YO LISTEN!
description_en:
+1 Luck
Highlights the location of secret rooms, tinted rocks and crawlspaces
description_zh:
幸运+1
使隐藏房, 标记石头和暗门的地点高亮
wiki_description: +1 luck. Spawns a fairy familiar that points out Secret Rooms, Crawl Space entrances, and tinted rocks.

name: Adrenaline
description_en:
Damage up for every empty heart container
The more empty heart containers, the bigger the bonus for each new one
description_zh:
空心之容器能提高伤害
空心之容器越多, 每个新的空心之容器的伤害加成越高
wiki_description: Increases damage based on how many empty Red Heart containers Isaac has.

name: Jacob's Ladder
description_en:
Tears spawn a spark of electricity on impact
Sparks deal half of Isaac's damage
Sparks can arc to up to 4 other enemies
description_zh:
泪弹击中时, 生成1道电弧
电弧造成0.5x角色伤害
电弧可电穿最多4个其他敌人
wiki_description: Tears fire sparks of electricity in random directions upon hitting an obstacle or enemy.

name: Ghost Pepper
description_en:
8% chance to shoot a blue fire that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage
 50% chance at 10 luck
Fires shrink and disappear after 2 seconds
description_zh:
8%概率发射蓝火, 能阻挡弹幕并造成接触伤害
 幸运10: 50%概率
火焰不断缩小, 2秒后消失
wiki_description: Category:Modified in RepentanceGives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them. Category:Modified in RepentanceGives a chance to shoot blue fires alongside tears that become smaller as they travel.

name: Euthanasia
description_en:
3.33% chance to shoot a needle
 25% chance at 13 luck
Needles kill normal enemies instantly, bursting them into 10 tears
 Needles deal 3x Isaac's damage against bosses
description_zh:
3.33%概率发射针
 幸运13: 25%概率
针会立即击杀通常敌人, 并爆出10颗泪弹
 针击中头目造成3x角色伤害
wiki_description: Adds a luck-based chance to fire needles that instantly kill basic enemies and deal triple damage to bosses. If a needle kills an enemy, it bursts into more tears/needles.

name: Camo Undies
description_en:
Entering a room camouflages Isaac and confuses all enemies until a tear is shot
 +0.5 Speed while cloaked
Uncloaking deals damage around Isaac and grants a very brief fire rate and damage up
description_zh:
进入房间时, 使所有敌人混乱并使角色伪装, 直到角色开始发射
 伪装时移速+0.5
解除伪装时, 对角色周围造成伤害, 并获得非常短暂的射速和伤害提升
wiki_description: Isaac becomes camouflaged at the beginning of each room. Until he shoots, all non-boss enemies will be confused. Category:Modified in Repentance Isaac gains +0.5 Speed while camouflaged, and gains Tears and Damage upon breaking it.

name: Duality
description_en:
Spawns both a Devil and Angel Room if either would have spawned
Entering one makes the other disappear
description_zh:
恶魔房和天使房生成时会同时生成
进入其一, 另一个就会消失
wiki_description: Whenever a Devil Room or Angel Room would spawn after defeating a boss, both rooms spawn. Only one can be entered.

name: Eucharist
description_en: 100% chance for Angel Rooms to spawn
description_zh: 天使房的概率变为100%
wiki_description: An Angel Room will always spawn after every boss fight, excluding the first floor and floors after Chapter 4.

name: Sack of Sacks
description_en: Spawns a sack every 7-8 rooms
description_zh: 每7-8个房间生成1福袋
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that drops a Grab Bag every few rooms cleared.

name: Greed's Gullet
description_en: +1 Heart container for every 25 coins Isaac has
description_zh: 角色每持有25硬币+1心之容器
wiki_description: Grants a Red Heart container for every 25 Coins Isaac has.

name: Large Zit
description_en:
Firing occasionally shoots a white creep tear that deals double damage and slows enemies
Taking damage shoots a white creep tear
description_zh:
发射时, 时不时额外发射一颗白色青春痘, 造成2x角色伤害并使敌人减速
受伤时, 向随机方向发射一颗青春痘
wiki_description: Adds a chance to fire a creep shot that deals double damage and leaves a trail of slowing white creep.

name: Little Horn
description_en:
5% chance to shoot a tear that summons a Big Horn hand
 20% chance at 15 luck
The hand instantly kills enemies and deals 36 damage to bosses
Isaac deals 7 contact damage per second
description_zh:
5%概率发射能召唤巨角恶魔的手的泪弹
 运气15: 20%概率
手会立即杀死敌人或对头目造成36点伤害
角色每秒造成7点接触伤害
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Adds a chance to fire a piercing tear that instantly kills any enemy that it touches. Category:Modified in Repentance Adds a chance to fire a tear that summons Big Horn's hand to crush the first enemy it hits, instantly killing monsters or greatly damaging bosses.

name: Brown Nugget
description_en:
Spawns a fly that shoots at enemies
Each shot deals 3.5 damage
description_zh:
生成1只向敌人发射的苍蝇炮塔
泪弹造成3.5点伤害
wiki_description: Spawns a stationary fly turret that lasts for the current room and fires tears at nearby enemies.

name: Poke Go
description_en: Entering a hostile room has a 20% chance to spawn a friendly enemy
description_zh: 进入有敌人的房间时, 20%概率生成友好的敌人
wiki_description: Upon entering a room with enemies in it, has a chance to spawn a random friendly enemy that persists across rooms.

name: Backstabber
description_en: Hitting an enemy in the back deals double damage and causes bleeding, which makes enemies leave creep and take damage when they move
description_zh: 若泪弹击中敌人后背, 则造成的伤害翻倍并造成流血, 使敌人留下水迹并在移动时受伤
wiki_description: Isaac's tears deal double damage and inflict bleeding on enemies if they're facing away from Isaac.

name: Sharp Straw
description_en:
Deals Isaac's damage + 10% of the enemy's max health to all enemies
 Dealing damage with the Straw have a 15% chance to spawn half hearts
description_zh:
对所有敌人造成1x角色伤害+敌人最大血量10%的伤害
 造成伤害时, 15%概率生成半红心
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart or Half Soul Heart if an enemy is hit. Category:Modified in Repentance Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart if an enemy is hit.

name: Mom's Razor
description_en:
Orbital that causes bleeding, which makes enemies take damage when they move
 Deals 1.5x Isaac's damage per second
description_zh:
能造成流血的环绕物, 使敌人在移动时受伤
 每秒造成1.5x角色伤害
wiki_description: Spawns an orbiting razor that deals contact damage and inflicts bleeding on enemies, causing them to slowly take damage over time.

name: Bloodshot Eye
description_en:
Orbital that shoots a tear every 0.33 seconds to nearby enemies
Deals 3.5 damage per tear
Deals 20 contact damage per second
description_zh:
附近有敌人时, 每0.33秒发射一颗泪弹的环绕物
泪弹造成3.5点伤害
每秒造成20点接触伤害
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Spawns an orbital familiar that deals contact damage and fires a tear every 2 seconds. Category:Modified in Repentance Spawns an orbital familiar that deals contact damage, blocks shots, and fires tears at enemies in its line of sight.

name: Delirious
description_en:
Spawns a friendly delirium version of a boss
Persists between rooms
 Only one boss can be active at a time
The health of the boss deteriorates over time
description_zh:
生成1个友好的精神错乱版的头目
切换房间持续存在
 一次只能激活1个头目
生成的头目血量会随时间流失
wiki_description: Spawns Delirium as a random friendly boss that fights for Isaac. Category:Modified in AfterbirthCategory:Modified in Repentance+ The boss lasts the for the current room. Category:Modified in Repentance+ The boss persists between rooms. The charge time is based on the power of the boss summoned.

name: Angry Fly
description_en:
Orbits a random enemy until that enemy dies
Deals 30 contact damage per second to other enemies
description_zh:
在随机敌人周围环绕直到该敌人死亡
每秒对其他敌人造成30点接触伤害
wiki_description: Spawns a fly familiar that orbits around a random enemy and deals 30 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.

name: Black Hole
description_en:
Throwable black hole, which sucks in everything
Deals 6 damage per second
Destroys nearby rocks
Lasts 6 seconds
description_zh:
可投掷的黑洞, 会吸入所有东西
每秒造成6点接触伤害
摧毁附近的石头
持续6秒
wiki_description: Throws a black hole on the ground which sucks in and damages enemies and destroys nearby obstacles.

name: Bozo
description_en:
+0.1 Damage
 +1 Soul Heart
 Randomly charms/fears enemies
Taking damage has a 5% chance to spawn a Rainbow Poop
description_zh:
伤害+0.1
 +1魂心
 概率魅惑/恐惧敌人
受伤时, 5%概率生成1个彩虹大便
wiki_description: +0.1 flat damage, grants a Soul Heart. Enemies can randomly become briefly charmed or feared. Taking damage has a chance to spawn a Rainbow Poop.

name: Broken Modem
description_en:
Causes some enemies and projectiles to briefly pause at random intervals
Paused projectiles disappear
25% chance to double room clear rewards
description_zh:
随机间隔使一些敌人和弹幕短暂停滞
暂停的弹幕消失
25%概率使清理房间奖励翻倍
wiki_description: Enemies, enemy shots, tears, and pickups will briefly freeze in place at random intervals. The reward from clearing a room will sometimes be duplicated.

name: Mystery Gift
description_en:
Spawns a random item from the current room's item pool
Chance to spawn Lump of Coal or The Poop instead
description_zh:
根据当前房间的道具池生成1个随机道具
概率生成煤块/大便
wiki_description: Spawns a random item from the current room's item pool, with a chance to spawn A Lump of Coal or The Poop instead.

name: Sprinkler
description_en: Spawns a Sprinkler that shoots the same tears as Isaac in a circle around itself
description_zh: 生成1个洒水器, 转圈发射泪弹
wiki_description: Creates a stationary sprinkler for the current room that rotates and fires tears in 8 directions. The tears copy Isaac's stats and most tear effects.

name: Fast Bombs
description_en:
+7 Bombs
Removes the delay between bomb placements
Bombs don't deal knockback to each other
description_zh:
+7炸弹
移除放置炸弹的冷却
炸弹相互之间不会击退
wiki_description: +7 Bombs. Removes the delay between bomb placements, allowing them to be placed rapidly. Category:Modified in Repentance Bombs will no longer knock each other away.

name: Buddy in a Box
description_en:
Familiar which looks like a random co-op baby
Has random tear effects
Effects change every floor
description_zh:
与合作宝宝外观一样的跟班
随机泪弹效果
效果每层都会变化
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar with a random tear effect. The familiar is randomized at the start of each floor.

name: Lil Delirium
description_en: Transforms into a random familiar every 10 seconds
description_zh: 每10秒变成随机跟班
wiki_description: Grants a familiar that transforms into another random familiar every 10 seconds.

name: Jumper Cables
description_en: Killing 15 enemies adds 1 charge to the active item
description_zh: 每击杀15个敌人主动道具充能1格
wiki_description: Grants an active item charge every 15 enemies killed.

name: Coupon
description_en:
Makes one random item in the Shop or Devil Room free
Holding the item guarantees one Shop item is on sale
description_zh:
使商店/恶魔房的随机1个物品免费
 持有时, 进入商店必有1个商店物品打折
wiki_description: While held, guarantees one item in every Shop will be on sale for half price. On use, makes a random item in the current room free.

name: Telekinesis
description_en:
Stops all enemy projectiles that come close to Isaac for 3 seconds and throws them away from him afterwards
Pushes close enemies away during the effect
description_zh:
使靠近角色的敌人弹幕停滞3秒, 结束后弹幕会被抛开
效果期间推开靠近的敌人
wiki_description: Any enemy shots that come near Isaac for the next three seconds are held in place then fired back.

name: Moving Box
description_en:
Stores up to 10 pickups and items from the current room
Using the item again drops everything back on the floor
Allows Isaac to move things between rooms
description_zh:
使用时, 储存当前房间中最多10掉落物
再次使用将储存物放回地上
允许角色在房间之间搬东西
wiki_description: If the box is empty, picks up items and pickups in a room and stores them. If the box is not empty, places all stored items and pickups in the current room. Category:Modified in Repentance Can carry up to 10 items or pickups at once.

name: Technology Zero
description_en:
Isaac's tears are connected with beams of electricity
Electricity deals 4.5x Isaac's damage per second
description_zh:
泪弹以电弧连接
 电弧每秒造成4.5x角色伤害
wiki_description: Connects Isaac's tears with electricity that can damage enemies.

name: Leprosy
description_en:
Taking damage spawns a projectile blocking orbital
Caps at 3 orbitals
They deal 30 contact damage per second
Orbitals are destroyed if they take too much damage
description_zh:
受伤时, 生成1个阻挡弹幕的环绕物
最多有3个环绕物
每秒造成30点接触伤害
环绕物受伤过多后被摧毁
wiki_description: Taking damage grants a body part orbital that blocks shots and deals contact damage, up to a maximum of three. The body parts are destroyed after blocking enough damage.

name: 7 Seals
description_en:
Spawns a small horseman familiar that spawns locusts
The horseman and its locust changes every 10 seconds
description_zh:
生成小天启骑士跟班, 能生成对应的蝗虫
骑士及其蝗虫每10秒更换一次
wiki_description: Spawns a random Harbinger familiar that changes every 10 seconds. Harbingers have different behaviors and spawn themed Locusts.

name: Mr. ME!
description_en:
Displays a movable cursor for a few seconds, then summons a ghost that will, depending on the cursor position:
Open doors or chests
Fetch an item
50% chance to steal from the Shop / Devil
Attack an enemy until it dies
Explode walls, rocks, shopkeepers, angel statues, machines, beggars
Presses the button
description_zh:
几秒内显示可移动光标, 随后生成幽灵, 根据光标位置:
打开门或箱子
带回物品
50%概率在商店/恶魔房偷东西
攻击敌人直到目标死亡
炸开墙/石头/天使雕像/店主/机器/乞丐
按下压力板
wiki_description: Summons a controllable ghost that can perform various tasks depending on what it targets.

name: Angelic Prism
description_en:
Orbital prism
Friendly tears hitting it split into 4
description_zh:
棱镜环绕物
友方泪弹击中它会分裂成4个
wiki_description: Spawns an orbital familiar with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.

name: Pop!
description_en: Isaac's tears bounce off each other and disappear when they stop moving
description_zh: 角色的泪弹会彼此弹开, 停止移动时消失
wiki_description: Replaces Isaac's tears with eyeballs that can bounce off of each other. The eyeballs are not limited by range, and will instead dissipate when they stop moving or when hitting an enemy or obstacle.

name: Death's List
description_en: Killing enemies in the order dictated by the mark above them grants a random pickup or stat increase
description_zh: 按顺序击杀标记的敌人可获得奖励
wiki_description: Grants a pickup or stat upgrade if all enemies in a room are killed in the order they are marked.

name: Haemolacria
description_en:
+1 Damage
 x1.5 Damage multiplier
 x0.33 Fire rate multiplier
 x0.8 Range multiplier
Isaac's tears fly in an arc and burst into smaller tears on impact
description_zh:
伤害+1
 伤害修正x1.5
 射速修正x0.33
 射程修正x0.8
角色的泪弹呈抛物线前进, 击中时分裂成更小的泪弹
wiki_description: Turns Isaac's tears into large blood tears fired in an arc. Upon hitting the floor, an obstacle, or an enemy, they burst into many smaller tears in all directions. Increases tear delay.

name: Lachryphagy
description_en:
Isaac's tears progressively slow down, stop, then explode into 5-8 smaller tears
Tears can merge and become bigger
description_zh:
角色的泪弹前进时减速, 停止后会爆裂成5-8颗小泪弹
泪弹可以合并变大
wiki_description: Isaac's tears decelerate as they travel. Upon stopping or hitting an obstacle, they burst into 8 tears in all directions. Tears can be fired into other tears to feed them, increasing their damage.

name: Trisagion
description_en:
Replaces Isaac's tears with piercing beams of light
The beams deal 33% damage but can hit enemies multiple times
description_zh:
角色的泪弹由穿刺光束弹取代
每秒造成15次33%角色伤害
wiki_description: Tears are replaced with piercing white blasts of light that deal less damage but can damage the same enemy multiple times.

name: Schoolbag
description_en:
Allows Isaac to hold 2 active items
The items can be swapped using the Drop button ()
description_zh:
允许角色持有2个主动道具
按掉落键()切换
wiki_description: Allows Isaac to hold two active items.

name: Blanket
description_en:
Heals 1 heart
 +1 Soul Heart
 Entering a boss room grants a Holy Mantle shield (prevents damage once)
description_zh:
治疗1红心
 +1魂心
 进入头目房时产生神圣屏障护盾, 阻挡1次伤害
wiki_description: Grants one Soul Heart. Upon entering a boss room, grants a shield that blocks one hit, then disappears.

name: Sacrificial Altar
description_en:
Sacrifices up to 2 familiars and spawns a devil item for each sacrifice
 Turns blue spiders/flies into coins
description_zh:
献祭最多2个跟班并生成同样数量的恶魔房道具
 将蓝蜘蛛/蓝苍蝇变成硬币
wiki_description: Sacrifices up to two familiars and spawns an item pedestal for each familiar sacrificed. Converts all friendly spiders and flies into coins.

name: Lil Spewer
description_en:
Spawns a random pill on pickup
Fires a line of creep
The type of creep changes with each pill use
description_zh:
生成1随机胶囊
发射一条水迹
每次使用胶囊后, 水迹类型改变
wiki_description: Drops a random pill, and spawns a familiar that charges up and fires creep. Using pills changes the creep type.

name: Marbles
description_en:
Spawns 3 random trinkets
 Taking damage has a 10% chance to consume Isaac's held trinket and grant its effects permanently
description_zh:
生成3随机饰品
 受伤时, 10%概率消耗角色持有的饰品并永久获得其效果
wiki_description: Spawns 3 random trinkets. Taking damage has a 5% chance to swallow Isaac's currently held trinket, gaining its effect permanently.

name: Mystery Egg
description_en:
Taking damage spawns a friendly enemy
Spawns stronger friends the more rooms are cleared without taking damage
description_zh:
受伤时, 生成1个友好的敌人
未受伤清理的房间越多, 生成的帮手更强
wiki_description: Spawns an egg familiar, which hatches a random friendly monster when Isaac is hurt once per room. The power of the monster improves for each consecutive room cleared without taking damage.

name: Flat Stone
description_en: Isaac's tears bounce off the floor and cause splash damage on every bounce
description_zh:
角色的泪弹会在地面弹起
 每次弹起对附近敌人造成0.25x角色伤害
wiki_description: Tears bounce off the floor, creating splashes. Splashes deal 25% of Isaac's tear damage to all enemies in a small area.

name: Marrow
description_en:
Spawns 3 Red Hearts
 +1 Bone Heart
description_zh:
生成3红心
 +1骨心
wiki_description: Grants one Bone Heart and spawns three Red Hearts.

name: Slipped Rib
description_en:
Orbital
Reflects enemy projectiles
description_zh:
环绕物
反弹敌人弹幕
wiki_description: Spawns a bone familiar that circles around Isaac and reflects enemy shots.

name: Hallowed Ground
description_en:
Taking damage spawns a white poop
While inside the poop's aura:
 x2.5 Fire rate multiplier
 x1.2 Damage multiplier
Homing tears
50% chance to block damage
description_zh:
受伤时, 生成白大便
在大便光环中时:
 射速修正x2.5
 伤害修正x1.2
追踪泪弹
50%概率阻挡伤害
wiki_description: Spawns a white poop familiar, which turns into a White Poop when Isaac is hurt. White poop has an aura that increases tear fire rate and can block enemy shots. Category:Modified in Repentance The aura also increases damage by 20% and gives homing.

name: Pointy Rib
description_en:
Levitates in front of Isaac
Deals 6x Isaac's damage per second
description_zh:
漂浮在角色前方的骨刺
每秒造成6x角色伤害
wiki_description: Spawns a bone familiar that hovers back and forth in front of Isaac, dealing damage equal to Isaac's damage.

name: Book of the Dead
description_en: Spawns a bone orbital or friendly bony per enemy killed in the room (up to 8)
description_zh:
当前房间中每击杀1个敌人, 生成1个骨头环绕物/友好的骷髅仔
最多生成8个
wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room. Category:Modified in Repentance Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, Bone Fly, Revenant, Big Bony, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room.

name: Dad's Ring
description_en: Grants an aura that petrifies enemies
description_zh: 获得能使敌人石化的光环
wiki_description: Creates a ring of light around Isaac that petrifies enemies in contact.

name: Divorce Papers
description_en:
+0.7 Tears
 +1 Bone Heart
 Spawns the Mysterious Paper trinket
description_zh:
射速+0.7
 +1骨心
 生成神秘纸片饰品
wiki_description: Grants one Bone Heart, +0.7 tears, spawns a Mysterious Paper .

name: Jaw Bone
description_en:
Boomerang-like familiar
Deals 7 contact damage
Can grab and bring back pickups
description_zh:
回旋镖状的跟班
造成7点接触伤害
能捡起并带回掉落物
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that flies through the room while firing, dealing a flat 7 contact damage to enemies and retrieving pickups.

name: Brittle Bones
description_en:
Replaces all of Isaac's Red Heart containers with 6 empty Bone Hearts
Upon losing a Bone Heart:
 +0.4 Fire rate
Shoots 10 bone tears in all directions
description_zh:
角色所有的心之容器由6空骨心取代
失去骨心时:
 射速修正+0.4
向四周方向发射10颗骨头泪弹
wiki_description: Replaces all Red Heart Containers with 6 empty Bone Hearts. Category:Modified in Repentance Upon losing a Bone Heart, Isaac fires bones in 8 directions and permanently gains a tears up. Category:Modified in Repentance Upon losing a Bone Heart, Isaac fires bones in 8 directions and permanently gains a fire rate up.

name: Broken Shovel
description_en:
Mom's Foot constantly tries to stomp Isaac
Using the item stops the stomping for the room (or one Boss Rush wave)
 (Try to beat Boss Rush with it!)
description_zh:
妈腿会持续攻击角色
使用后, 在当前房间中(或头目车轮战1波次)妈腿攻击停止
 (试着带着它通过头目车轮战!)
wiki_description: While held, causes Mom to continuously attempt to stomp on Isaac. Activating makes her stop for the current room or wave. One of two parts necessary to create Mom's Shovel .

name: Broken Shovel
description_en:
Completes Mom's Shovel
 Use the shovel on the mound of dirt in the "Dark Room"
description_zh:
铲子碎片的第二部分
 在"暗室"的土丘上使用铲子
wiki_description: One of two parts necessary to create Mom's Shovel . No effect if somehow obtained on its own.

name: Mom's Shovel
description_en:
Spawns a trapdoor to the next floor
 Spawns a crawlspace if used on a decorative floor tile (grass, small rocks, papers, gems, etc.)
 Use the shovel on the mound of dirt in the "Dark Room"
description_zh:
生成通往下一层的活板门
 在有装饰(草/碎石/纸/宝石等)的地板上使用时, 改为生成暗门
 在"暗室"的土丘上使用铲子
wiki_description: Creates a trapdoor that leads to the next floor. Unlocks The Forgotten when used on a mound of dirt that appears in Dark Room.

name: Mucormycosis
description_en:
25% chance to shoot a sticky spore tear
 Not affected by luck
 Spores blow up after 2.5 seconds, dealing damage, poisoning nearby enemies and releasing more spores
description_zh:
25%概率发射粘性孢子泪弹
 不受幸运影响
孢子命中后2.5秒爆炸, 造成伤害, 使附近敌人中毒并释放更多孢子
wiki_description: Gives Isaac the chance to fire spore tears that stick to enemies and blow up after a few seconds, dealing damage and poisoning nearby enemies and releasing more spores.

name: 2Spooky
description_en:
+0.5 Fire rate
 +0.2 Shot speed
 Fears enemies in a small radius around Isaac
description_zh:
射速修正+0.5
 弹速+0.2
 使近距离的敌人恐惧
wiki_description: Enemies near Isaac are afflicted with fear. Category:Modified in Repentance+ Grants +0.5 tears and +0.2 shot speed.

name: Golden Razor
description_en:
+5 coins on pickup
 Pay 5 coins and receive for the room:
 +1.2 Damage
description_zh:
拾起时+5硬币
 花费5硬币, 并在当前房间中获得:
 伤害+1.2
wiki_description: Spends 5 pennies to grant +1.2 damage for the current room. Grants 5 pennies when picked up for the first time.

name: Sulfur
description_en:
Brimstone for the room
Using it multiple times in one room grants increased damage and a larger beam
description_zh:
在当前房间中获得硫磺火
多次使用使伤害更高, 激光更大
wiki_description: Grants Brimstone for the current room.

name: Fortune Cookie
description_en:
Grants one of the following rewards:
A fortune
 A Soul Heart
 A Rune or Soul Stone
 A Tarot card
 A Trinket
description_zh:
获得其一:
1条预言
 1魂心
 1符文/魂石
 1塔罗牌
 1饰品
wiki_description: Gives Isaac a fortune, Soul Heart, Card, Rune, or trinket, similar to a Fortune Telling Machine. Fortunes are much more likely to be given than anything else.

name: Eye Sore
description_en:
Chance to shoot 1-3 extra tears in random directions
 Not affected by luck
description_zh:
概率向随机方向发射1-3颗额外泪弹
 不受幸运影响
wiki_description: Causes Isaac to occasionally fire extra tears in random directions while shooting.

name: 120 Volt
description_en:
Repeatedly zaps nearby enemies
 Electricity deals up to 3.75x Isaac's damage per second
Sparks can arc to up to 4 other enemies
description_zh:
反复电击附近敌人
 电击每秒造成3.75x角色伤害
电弧可电穿最多4个其他敌人
wiki_description: Repeatedly zaps enemies that are close to Isaac.

name: It Hurts
description_en:
When taking damage, receive for the room:
 +1.2 Fire rate on the first hit
 +0.4 Fire rate for each additional hit
Releases a ring of 10 tears around Isaac
Tears leave a pool of creep on impact
description_zh:
受伤时, 在当前房间中获得:
 首次受伤射速修正+1.2
 后续受伤射速修正+0.4
在角色周围释放10颗泪弹
泪弹击中时留下水迹
wiki_description: Releases a ring of tears and increases fire rate for the current room when Isaac takes damage. Category:Modified in Repentance+ Isaac's tears also leave pools of red creep for the rest of the room.

name: Almond Milk
quote: DMG down + tears up + you feel nutty
description_en:
x4 Fire rate multiplier
 x0.3 Damage multiplier
 -0.16 Tear size
Tears gain random worm trinket effects and some item effects
description_zh:
射速修正x4
 伤害修正x0.3
 泪弹尺寸-0.16
泪弹随机获得蠕虫饰品和一些道具的效果
wiki_description: Quadruples fire rate, with ×0.3 damage multiplier. Each tear is given a random effect that alters its movement.

name: Rock Bottom
description_en: Prevents stats from being lowered for the rest of the run
description_zh: 本局游戏中属性不会再降低
wiki_description: Prevents Isaac's attributes from being lowered.

name: Nancy Bombs
description_en:
+5 Bombs
Isaac's bombs explode with random effects
description_zh:
+5炸弹
炸弹具有随机爆炸效果
wiki_description: +5 Bombs. Each bomb gains 1-4 random bomb synergies.

name: A Bar of Soap
description_en:
+0.5 Tears
 +0.2 Shot speed
wiki_description: +0.5 Tears, +0.2 Shot Speed.

name: Blood Puppy
description_en:
Chases enemies
After killing 15 enemies, it deals more damage, spawns a half Red Heart every 10 kills, but tries to hurt Isaac
After killing 40 enemies, it deals even more damage, spawns full Red Hearts, and can destroy rocks
Dealing enough damage to it returns it to its first phase
description_zh:
追击敌人
击杀15个敌人后, 会造成更多伤害, 每击杀10个敌人掉落半红心, 但也会尝试对角色造成伤害
击杀40个敌人后, 会造成更多伤害, 掉落整红心, 可以摧毁石头
对其造成足够多伤害可使其回到第一阶段
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that chases enemies. After killing enough enemies, it becomes more powerful but will also try to hurt Isaac. Dealing enough damage to it returns it to normal.

name: Dream Catcher
description_en:
+1 half Soul Heart when entering a new floor
The stage transition nightmare reveals the next floor's boss fight and Treasure Room item
description_zh:
进入新层时+1半魂心
在每层过场噩梦中显示下一层的头目战和宝箱房道具
wiki_description: During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the contents of the upcoming floor's Treasure Room, as well as the floor's boss. Grants a Half Soul Heart when entering a new floor.

name: Paschal Candle
description_en:
Clearing a room without taking damage grants +0.4 Fire rate
Caps at +2 Fire rate (5 rooms)
description_zh:
若清理房间且不受伤害, 则射速修正+0.4
最多+2(5个房间)
wiki_description: Gives Isaac a familiar that grants +0.4 Fire Rate for each consecutive room he's cleared without taking damage. The bonus stacks up to five times.

name: Divine Intervention
description_en:
Double-tapping a fire key creates a shield
The shield lasts 1 second, pushes enemies away and reflects enemy projectiles and lasers
description_zh:
双击发射键产生护盾
护盾持续1秒, 能推开敌人, 反弹敌人弹幕和激光
wiki_description: Double tapping a fire key creates a shield that pushes away enemies and reflects enemy projectiles and lasers.

name: Blood Oath
description_en:
Entering a new floor drains all of Isaac's Red Hearts, but grants speed and damage bonuses for each heart lost
Each half heart lost counts as an individual hit for on-hit effects
description_zh:
进入新层时, 吸走角色的所有红心, 但根据失去的红心获得移速和伤害加成
致死时保留半红心
对于受击效果, 每失去半红心都算作单独一击
wiki_description: Stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor, draining his Red Hearts. Increases damage and speed for the floor based on the amount drained.

name: Playdough Cookie
description_en: Each of Isaac's tears have a different color and status effect
description_zh: 角色的每颗泪弹都有不同的颜色和效果
wiki_description: Grants multicolored tears. Each color comes with a different status or tear effect.

name: Orphan Socks
quote: Speed up + your feet feel stronger
description_en:
+0.3 Speed
 +2 Soul Hearts
Immune to creep and floor spikes
description_zh:
移速+0.3
 +2魂心
免疫水迹和地刺
wiki_description: Prevents creep and floor spikes from damaging Isaac. Also gives Isaac +0.3 speed and 2 Soul Hearts.

name: Eye of the Occult
quote: DMG up + range up + controlled tears
description_en:
+1 Damage
 +2 Range
 -0.16 Shot speed
Isaac's tears can be controlled in mid-air
description_zh:
伤害+1
 射程+2
 弹速-0.16
角色的泪弹飞行时可控
wiki_description: +1 damage, +2 range, -0.16 shot speed. Isaac's tears can be controlled mid-flight with tear controls.

name: Immaculate Heart
description_en:
+1 Health
 x1.2 Damage multiplier
 Full health
20% chance to shoot an extra orbiting spectral tear
description_zh:
+1心之容器
 伤害修正x1.2
 回满血
20%概率额外发射1颗环绕灵体泪弹
wiki_description: Adds one Red Heart Container and fully restores health. x1.2 damage multiplier. Isaac will occasionally fire extra tears that orbit around him.

name: Monstrance
description_en:
Isaac is surrounded by a damaging aura
The closer enemies are to Isaac, the more damage the aura deals to them
description_zh:
角色获得造成伤害的光环
敌人越靠近角色, 光环造成的伤害越高
wiki_description: Isaac gains an aura that deals damage to enemies inside it.

name: The Intruder
description_en:
Buries itself in Isaac's head and shoots 4 extra slowing tears that deal 1.5 damage
Taking damage has a 25% chance to make the spider exit the head and chase enemies
description_zh:
蜘蛛埋在角色头里, 额外发射4颗减速泪弹, 造成1.5点伤害
受伤时, 蜘蛛有25%概率离开头并追击敌人
wiki_description: A familiar burrows in Isaac's head, firing 4 slowing tears. Upon taking damage, there's a chance it will burst out of Isaac's head, spawning blue spiders and chasing enemies for the current room.

name: Dirty Mind
description_en:
All Dip (small poop) enemies are friendly
Destroying poop spawns 1-4 Dips
Dip type depends on the poop type
Rocks have a 6.25% chance to be replaced with poop
description_zh:
所有粪滴敌人变得友好
摧毁大便时, 生成1-4个粪滴
粪滴类型取决于大便类型
石头有6.25%概率会由大便取代
wiki_description: Destroying poop spawns Dip Familiars that follow Isaac and damage enemies. Destroying different types of poop spawns different Dips with special effects.

name: Damocles
quote: A king's fortune... but at what cost?
description_en:
Hangs a sword above Isaac's head, which doubles all pedestal items
Does not double items that have a price or come from chests
 After taking any damage, the sword has an extremely low chance to instantly kill Isaac every frame
Invincibility effects can prevent the death
description_zh:
在角色头上悬着剑, 并使底座道具翻倍
有价格或箱子中的道具不翻倍
 受伤后, 剑每帧有极低概率立即击杀角色
无敌效果可以避免死亡
wiki_description: Spawns a sword above Isaac's head, which doubles all item pedestals. After Isaac takes damage, the sword can randomly fall at any point, instantly killing him.

name: Free Lemonade
description_en:
Creates a large pool of yellow creep
The creep deals 24 damage per second
description_zh:
生成大范围的黄色水迹
水迹每秒造成24点伤害
wiki_description: Creates a large pool of yellow creep beneath Isaac.

name: Spirit Sword
description_en:
Instead of shooting tears, swing a sword
 The sword deals 3x Isaac's damage +3.5 and swings as fast as the fire button is tapped
 Charging does a spin attack + projectile shot
Shoots projectiles with swings at full health
description_zh:
攻击方式改为挥剑
 剑造成3x角色伤害+3.5的伤害, 挥剑速度与按发射键速度一样快
 可蓄力发动旋转攻击
满血时发射剑气
wiki_description: Instead of tears, Isaac swings a sword. Charging does a spin attack and fires a projectile, and a projectile is sometimes fired with normal swings if Isaac has no empty Red Heart Containers.

name: Red Key
description_en:
Creates a red room adjacent to a regular room, indicated by a door outline
Red Rooms can be special rooms
 Entering a room outside the 13x13 floor map teleports Isaac to the I AM ERROR room
description_zh:
在常规房间旁产生门形轮廓指示的红色房间
红色房间可以是特殊房间
 进入13x13地图范围外的房间时, 将角色传送至错误房
wiki_description: Creates a Red Room adjacent to a viable wall, indicated by the outline of a door. These rooms have a 10% chance to be a special room.

name: Psy Fly
description_en:
Chases and blocks enemy projectiles
Deals 15 contact damage per second
description_zh:
追击并阻挡敌人弹幕
每秒造成15点接触伤害
wiki_description: Spawns a fly orbital familiar that seeks out incoming enemy shots and destroys them.

name: Wavy Cap
quote: Tears up. A mind changing experience!
description_en:
+0.75 Fire rate
 -0.03 Speed
Distorts the screen
Takes longer to recharge each use
Leaving or clearing rooms reduces the effects
description_zh:
射速修正+0.75
 移速-0.03
扭曲画面
每次使用后延长充能时间
离开或清理房间可减弱效果
wiki_description: Increases tears, decreases speed, and distorts the screen. All effects become more pronounced with repeated use, and wear off by clearing rooms.

name: Rocket in a Jar
description_en:
+5 Bombs
Placing a bomb while shooting fires a rocket in that direction instead
description_zh:
+5炸弹
发射时放置炸弹, 炸弹由发射火箭取代
wiki_description: +5 Bombs. If Isaac is currently firing, placing a bomb will instead shoot a fast-moving, explosive rocket in the direction he's facing.

name: Book of Virtues
description_en:
+12.5% Angel Room chance while held
Spawns an orbital wisp familiar that shoots spectral tears but can be destroyed
Can be combined with a second active item to create special wisps
 Turns the first Devil Room into an Angel Room
 Allows Angel Rooms to spawn after taking a Devil deal
description_zh:
持有时, 天使房概率+12.5%
生成1魂火环绕跟班, 发射灵体泪弹但可被摧毁
与其它主动道具组合可产生特殊魂火
 将第一个恶魔房变为天使房
 恶魔交易后仍会出现天使房
wiki_description: Passively causes active items to spawn themed orbital wisp familiars on use, which fire tears and block shots. Can be activated to spawn a basic wisp if Isaac has no other active item.

name: Alabaster Box
description_en:
Must be charged by picking up Soul Hearts, then spawns:
 Three Soul Hearts
 Two Angel Room items
 Only spawns 2 Soul Hearts and 1 Angel item if a Devil deal was taken previously
description_zh:
必须通过拾起魂心充能, 使用时生成:
 3魂心
 2个天使房道具
 若已进行过恶魔交易, 则改为2魂心和1个天使房道具
wiki_description: Upon use, spawns three Soul Hearts and two Angel Room items and is consumed. Starts with no charges, and can only be charged by picking up 6 Soul Hearts.

name: The Stairway
quote: May you get what you came for
description_en: Spawns a ladder in the first room of every floor that leads to a unique Angel Room shop with items and pickups
description_zh: 在每层的初始房间生成梯子, 通向特殊天使房商店
wiki_description: Generates a ladder at the start of every floor that leads to a unique Angel Room shop.

name: Sol
description_en:
Reveals the location of the Boss Room
 When the floor boss is defeated, receive for the floor:
 +3 Damage
 +1 Luck
 The Sun effect
 Fully recharges the active item
 Removes any curses
description_zh:
揭示头目房位置
 击败头目后, 在本层获得:
 伤害+3
 幸运+1
 太阳的效果
 将主动道具完全充能
 移除诅咒
wiki_description: Reveals the location of the Boss Room. Upon defeating a boss, activates XIX - The Sun , fully recharges Isaac's active item, grants bonus damage and luck for the rest of the floor, and removes curses.

name: Luna
quote: The moon's blessing shines upon you
description_en:
Adds an extra Secret Room and Super Secret Room to each floor
Reveals one Secret Room each floor
 Secret Rooms contain a beam of light that grant for the floor:
 +0.5 Fire rate
 Additional +0.5 Fire rate from the first beam per floor
 Half a Soul Heart
description_zh:
每层额外增加1个隐藏房和超级隐藏房
每层揭示1个隐藏房
 隐藏房内有光束, 接触时在本层获得:
 射速修正+0.5
 每层首个光柱额外+0.5射速修正
 1半魂心
wiki_description: Adds an extra Secret Room and Super Secret Room to each floor. Secret Rooms contain a beam of light that increases Fire Rate for the current floor and gives a Half Soul Heart.

name: Mercurius
description_en:
+0.4 Speed
Most doors stay permanently open
description_zh:
移速+0.4
大多数门会永久保持打开
wiki_description: +0.4 speed. Doors stay open after entering a room, even in rooms with enemies.

name: Venus
description_en:
+1 Health
 Heals 1 heart
 Charms nearby enemies
description_zh:
+1心之容器
 治疗1红心
 魅惑附近敌人
wiki_description: Adds one red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart. Enemies near Isaac become charmed.

name: Terra
description_en:
+1 Damage
Replaces Isaac's tears with rocks
Rocks deal variable damage, can destroy obstacles and have increased knockback
description_zh:
伤害+1
角色的泪弹由石头取代
石头伤害不定, 可摧毁障碍物并有更强的击退力
wiki_description: +1 Damage. Replaces tears with rocks that deal variable damage, have increased knockback, and can destroy obstacles.

name: Mars
description_en:
Double-tapping a movement key makes Isaac dash
 During a dash, Isaac is invincible and deals 4x his damage +8
 3 seconds cooldown
 Creates a ring of fire on impact
description_zh:
双击移动键使角色冲锋
 冲锋时角色无敌, 造成4x角色伤害+8的伤害
 3秒冷却
 撞击时在角色周围生成火圈
wiki_description: Dash by double-tapping the movement key, becoming invulnerable and damaging enemies. There's a short cooldown before Isaac can dash again. Category:Modified in Repentance+ Knocks away nearby enemies and briefly grants i-frames after dashing.

name: Jupiter
description_en:
+2 Empty heart containers
 -0.3 Speed
 Heals 2 heart
 Speed builds up to +0.5 while standing still
 Moving releases poison clouds
 Poison immunity
description_zh:
+2空心之容器
 移速-0.3
 治疗2红心
 静止不动时, 移速逐渐升高至+0.5
 移动时释放毒气
 免疫中毒
wiki_description: +2 red Heart containers, -0.3 speed. Isaac builds speed while standing still, and releases poison gas clouds when he moves afterwards.

name: Saturnus
description_en:
Entering a room causes 7 tears to orbit Isaac
Those tears last for 13 seconds and deal 1.5x Isaac's damage +5
Enemy projectiles have a chance to orbit Isaac
description_zh:
进入房间时生成7颗泪弹在角色周围环绕
这些泪弹持续13秒, 造成1.5x角色伤害+5的伤害
敌人弹幕有概率加入环绕
wiki_description: Upon entering a room, a circle of 7 tears orbits Isaac, which last for 13 seconds before falling to the ground. Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in orbit, turning them friendly.

name: Uranus
description_en:
Isaac shoots petrifying tears that freeze enemies on death
Touching a frozen enemy makes it slide away and explode into 10 ice shards
description_zh:
角色发射冰冻泪弹, 击杀敌人时使其冻结
可以推开冻结的敌人, 撞碎时向四周发射10个冰锥
wiki_description: Isaac shoots ice tears, which slow enemies and freeze monsters they kill. Frozen enemies slide away and explode into ice shards when touched.

name: Neptunus
description_en:
Not shooting builds up a tear bonus over 3 seconds
The tear bonus decreases as Isaac shoots
description_zh:
不发射时3秒内累积射速加成
角色发射时降低射速加成
wiki_description: Isaac's mouth fills with tears over time while not firing, up to a cap. Holding the fire button will release all stored tears in rapid succession.

name: Pluto
description_en:
+0.7 Tears
Significantly shrinks Isaac, allowing him to squeeze between objects
Projectiles can pass over him
description_zh:
射速+0.7
角色大幅缩小, 允许挤过物体
弹幕可以越过角色
wiki_description: +0.7 tears. Significantly shrinks Isaac, allowing him to squeeze between objects and makes some enemy shots pass over him.

name: Voodoo Head
description_en:
Spawns an additional Curse Room each floor
Improves Curse Room layouts and rewards
 Spawns a coin in every Curse Room
description_zh:
每层额外生成1个诅咒房
升级诅咒房的布局和奖励
 每个诅咒房生成1硬币
wiki_description: Spawns an additional Curse Room on each floor. Curse Rooms have improved layouts.

name: Eye Drops
description_en: x1.4 Fire rate multiplier for the left eye
description_zh: 左眼射速修正x1.4
wiki_description: Increases the fire rate in Isaac's left eye, causing his eyes to fire at different rates.

name: Act of Contrition
description_en:
+0.7 Tears
 +1 Eternal Heart
 Allows Angel Rooms to spawn even after taking a devil deal
Taking Red Heart damage doesn't reduce Devil/Angel Room chance as much
description_zh:
射速+0.7
 +1永恒之心
 进行过恶魔交易后天使房仍然会出现
 减缓受红心伤害后减少恶魔房/天使房的概率
wiki_description: +0.7 tears, grants an Eternal Heart. Allows Angel Rooms to appear even if a Devil Deal has been taken before. Reduces the Devil/Angel room chance penalty for taking Red heart damage.

name: Member Card
description_en:
Opens a trapdoor in every Shop
The trapdoor leads to an underground shop that sells trinkets, runes, cards, special hearts and items from any pool
description_zh: 在商店内生成1个通往地下商店的暗门, 售卖饰品, 符文, 卡牌, 特殊心和任意道具池的道具
wiki_description: Adds a trapdoor to every Shop that leads to a second shop with a unique stock and marked-up prices.

name: Battery Pack
description_en:
Spawns 2-4 batteries
 Fully recharges the active item
description_zh:
生成2-4电池
 将主动道具完全充能
wiki_description: Recharges Isaac's currently held active item and drops 2-4 batteries.

name: Mom's Bracelet
description_en:
Allows Isaac to pick up and throw rocks, TNT, poops, friendly Dips, Hosts and other obstacles
Allows carrying them between rooms
description_zh:
允许角色举起并投掷石头/TNT/大便/友好粪滴/寄居骷髅等障碍物
举起的东西可以带到其他房间
wiki_description: Lets Isaac pick up and throw rocks, TNT, Poops, friendly Dips, Bombs, and other obstacles.

name: The Scooper
description_en:
x1.35 Damage multiplier for the right eye
 Summons a Peeper familiar for the room, which leaves a trail of red creep and deals 36 contact damage per second
description_zh:
右眼伤害修正x1.35
 在当前房间中召唤1个眼球跟班, 每秒造成36点伤害并留下血迹
wiki_description: Summons The Peeper for the current room, which leaves a trail of red creep.

name: Ocular Rift
description_en:
5% chance to shoot tears that create rifts where they land
 20% chance at 15 luck
Rifts do 3x Isaac's damage per second and pull in nearby enemies, pickups, and projectiles
description_zh:
5%概率发射在落地时生成裂隙的泪弹
 幸运15: 20%概率
裂隙每秒造成3x角色伤害, 并吸引附近的敌人, 掉落物和弹幕
wiki_description: Adds a chance to fire tears that create rifts where they land, which suck enemies, pickups, and shots towards them and damage enemies in the area.

name: Boiled Baby
description_en:
Shoots chaotic bursts of tears in all directions
Deals 3.5 or 5.25 damage per tear
description_zh:
向四周随机喷射泪弹
泪弹造成3.5或5.25点伤害
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires chaotic bursts of tears in all directions.

name: Freezer Baby
description_en:
Shoots petrifying tears that deal 3.5 damage
 Freezes enemies upon killing them
description_zh:
发射石化泪弹, 造成3.5点伤害
 击杀时使敌人冻结
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires icicles have a chance to petrify enemies and freeze monsters they kill.

name: Eternal D6
description_en:
Rerolls all pedestal items in the room
Has a 25% chance to delete items instead of rerolling them
description_zh:
重置房间中所有道具
25%概率删除道具而不是重置
wiki_description: Re-rolls all items in the room. Each item has a 25% chance to disappear instead.

name: Bird Cage
description_en:
Leaps on the enemy that deals the first damage to Isaac in a room
Deals 45 damage and releases a rock wave
Chases enemies afterwards for 6.5 contact damage per second
description_zh:
角色在房间中首次受伤时, 跃向敌人
造成45点伤害并释放岩石波
之后追击敌人, 每秒造成6.5点接触伤害
wiki_description: The first time Isaac takes damage in a room, a familiar leaps on an enemy, dealing damage and releasing a rock wave. For the rest of the room, it chases enemies similar to Dead Bird .

name: Larynx
description_en:
Isaac screams, damages and knocks back nearby enemies
The scream gets stronger the more charges the item has
description_zh:
角色怒吼, 击退周围的敌人并造成伤害
充能越多, 怒吼效果越强
wiki_description: Isaac shouts, damaging and pushing away nearby enemies. The shout gets stronger the more charges the item has. Larynx gains 1 charge whenever Isaac takes damage, in addition to charging normally.

name: Lost Soul
description_en:
Dies in one hit and respawns at the start of the next floor
If it is brought alive to the next floor, it can spawn:
 3 Soul Hearts
 2 Eternal Hearts
 A Treasure Room item
 An Angel Room item
description_zh:
受伤时死亡, 会在下一层重生
如果存活时带到下一层, 可能生成:
 3魂心
 2永恒之心
 1个宝箱房道具
 1个天使房道具
wiki_description: Creates a ghostly familiar that closely follows behind Isaac. It dies in one hit, but respawns at the start of the next floor. Each time it survives until the next floor, it rewards Isaac with Soul Hearts, Eternal Hearts, or an Item.

name: Blood Bombs
description_en:
+1 Health
 Heals 4 hearts
 If Isaac has no bombs, one can be placed at the cost of half a heart
Isaac's bombs leave red creep
description_zh:
+1心之容器
 治疗4红心
 若角色没有炸弹, 则可以花费半心放置炸弹
角色的炸弹会留下血迹
wiki_description: Grants a Red Heart container and restores 5 hearts. Bombs leave behind damaging red creep. Isaac can place Bombs at the cost of half a heart if he doesn't have any.

name: Lil Dumpy
description_en:
Deflects an enemy or projectile right before Isaac would take damage from it
Needs to be touched after deflecting to be reactivated
description_zh:
角色即将受伤时, 弹开敌人或弹幕
弹开后需要触碰才能再次激活
wiki_description: Spawns a Dumpy familiar that pushes away nearby enemies and projectiles just before Isaac is about to be hit, then falls asleep. He can be awoken by walking to him.

name: Bird's Eye
description_en:
8% chance to shoot a red fire that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage
 50% chance at 10 luck
Fires disappear after blocking 4 shots, dealing damage 4 times or after 10 seconds
description_zh:
8%概率发射红火, 阻挡敌人弹幕并造成接触伤害
 幸运10: 50%概率
火焰造成或阻挡4次伤害后或10秒后消失
wiki_description: Gives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them.

name: Lodestone
description_en:
17% chance to shoot magnetizing tears
 100% chance at 5 luck
Magnetized enemies attract nearby pickups, projectiles and enemies
description_zh:
17%概率发射使敌人磁化的泪弹
 运气5: 100%概率
磁化的敌人吸引掉落物, 弹幕和其它敌人
wiki_description: Gives Isaac the chance to fire tears that magnetize enemies they hit, causing them to attract nearby pickups and enemies, as well as tears/shots from all sources.

name: Rotten Tomato
description_en:
17% chance to shoot tears that mark enemies
 100% chance at 5 luck
Marked enemies are targeted by other enemies
description_zh:
17%概率发射标记敌人的泪弹
 运气5: 100%概率
被标记的敌人会被其他敌人攻击
wiki_description: Adds a chance to fire tears that mark enemies with the Bait status effect. Enemies marked as bait are attacked by other enemies.

name: Birthright
description_en: Has a different effect for each character
description_zh: 不同角色效果不同
wiki_description: Grants a character-specific effect that enhances their special abilities.

name: Red Stew
description_en:
+21.6 Damage
 Full health
The damage up wears off over 3 minutes
Killing enemies while the effect is active extends it
description_zh:
伤害+21.6
 回满血
增加的伤害在3分钟内会不断衰减
效果尚存时击杀敌人会延长时间
wiki_description: Refills all heart containers. Grants an enormous damage boost that wears off over time.

name: Genesis
description_en:
Removes all of Isaac's items and pickups
Teleports Isaac to a bedroom with pickups and chests
For every item removed, Isaac can choose between 3 items from the same pool
Leaving the bedroom takes Isaac to the next floor
description_zh:
移除角色的所有道具和掉落物
将角色传送至特殊的卧室, 内有掉落物和箱子
每移除1个道具, 角色就可从来自相同道具池的3个道具选择
离开卧室时, 将角色带到下一层
wiki_description: Removes all of Isaac's items and pickups and takes him to a unique Clean Bedroom with some pickups and Chests and a passage to the next floor. For every item Isaac lost, he gets to take an item from a set of three.

name: Sharp Key
description_en:
+5 Keys
Throws one of Isaac's keys in the direction he shoots
Thrown keys deal damage, destroy obstacles, and open doors
Enemies killed with keys can spawn the contents of a chest, including items
description_zh:
+5钥匙
向角色发射方向投掷角色的1钥匙
投掷的钥匙可造成伤害, 摧毁障碍物或开门
被钥匙击杀的敌人有概率掉落箱子里的物品, 包括道具
wiki_description: Adds 5 Keys on pickup. Allows Isaac to throw his keys to deal damage to enemies, destroy obstacles, and open doors.

name: Booster Pack
description_en: Spawns 5 random cards
description_zh: 生成5随机卡牌
wiki_description: Drops 5 random cards.

name: Mega Mush
description_en:
Gigantifies Isaac and grants:
 x4 Damage multiplier
 +2 Range
 -1.9 Tears
Invincibility
Ability to crush enemies and obstacles
 Lasts for 30 seconds and persists between rooms and floors
description_zh:
角色巨化并获得:
 伤害修正x4
 射程+2
 射速-1.9
无敌
能踩碎障碍物和敌人
 持续30秒, 能在房间之间和层之间持续
wiki_description: Gigantifies Isaac for 30 seconds, increasing damage and range while lowering tears, granting invulnerability, and allowing Isaac to crush enemies and obstacles he walks on. The effect persists between rooms.

name: Knife Piece 1
description_en:
Turns into a throwable knife that deals 25 damage when combined with Knife Piece 2
The knife can open a door made of flesh
description_zh:
与菜刀碎片2结合变为可投掷的菜刀, 造成25点伤害
菜刀能打开红色肉门
wiki_description: Combined with Knife Piece 2 , creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the Corpse.

name: Knife Piece 2
description_en:
Turns into a throwable knife that deals 25 damage when combined with Knife Piece 1
The knife can open a door made of flesh
description_zh:
与菜刀碎片1结合变为可投掷的菜刀, 造成25点伤害
菜刀能打开红色肉门
wiki_description: Combined with Knife Piece 1 , creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the Corpse.

name: Death Certificate
description_en:
Teleports Isaac to a floor that contains every item in the game
Choosing an item from this floor teleports Isaac back to the room he came from
description_zh:
将角色传送至含有所有游戏道具的一层
拾起1个道具后回到之前的房间
wiki_description: Transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of Home, which contains one copy of every item in the game. After taking an item, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.

name: Bot Fly
description_en:
Shoots shielded tears to destroy enemy projectiles
Deals 3 contact damage per second
description_zh:
发射能摧毁敌人弹幕的护盾泪弹
每秒造成3点接触伤害
wiki_description: Spawns an orbiting fly familiar that fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles.

name: Meat Cleaver
description_en:
Splits all enemies in the room into 2 smaller versions with 40% health
Enemies that naturally split (like Envy) take enough damage to split instead
Deals 25 damage to enemies that can't be split
description_zh:
使敌人分裂为2个40%血量的小型版本
本身能分裂的敌人(比如嫉妒)改为造成分裂所需的伤害
对无法分裂的敌人造成25点伤害
wiki_description: Splits all enemies in the room into two smaller versions of themselves with much less health.

name: Evil Charm
description_en:
+2 Luck
Immune to fire damage, confusion, fear, spider-webs and poison effects
Grants 1 second immunity to creep
description_zh:
幸运+2
免疫火焰伤害, 混乱, 恐惧, 蜘蛛网, 毒气效果
获得1秒水迹免疫
wiki_description: +2 luck. Provides immunity to burn, confusion, fear, and poison. Category:Modified in Repentance+ Prevents slowdown from cobwebs, and allows Isaac to stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.

name: Dogma
description_en:
+0.1 Speed
 +2 Damage
Flight and one-time Holy Mantle shield
 Heals Isaac with Red and Soul Hearts if he has less than 6 hearts
description_zh:
移速+0.1
 伤害+2
飞行, 单次神圣屏障护盾
 若角色少于6心, 则以红心和魂心治疗至6心
wiki_description: Grants flight, +2 damage, and increases speed to 1.1. Grants enough health to have 6 full hearts, if possible. Grants the Holy Mantle effect for the room it was obtained in. Automatically given to Isaac after defeating Dogma.

name: Purgatory
description_en:
Red cracks spawn on the ground in hostile rooms
Walking over the cracks summons homing exploding ghosts
description_zh:
在有敌人的房间中的地面生成红色裂缝
走过裂缝时会召唤追踪爆炸幽灵
wiki_description: While in a room with enemies, spawns red cracks in the ground. Walking over these cracks summons ghosts that launch themselves at enemies and explode.

name: Stitches
description_en:
Spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots
On use, Isaac swaps places with the familiar and becomes briefly invincible
Teleporting onto things can damage or destroy them
description_zh:
生成1个跟班, 向角色发射方向移动
使用时, 角色与跟班互换位置, 并短暂无敌
传送到物体上可以造成伤害或将其摧毁
wiki_description: Passively spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. On use, Isaac swaps places with the familiar.

name: R Key
description_en:
Restarts the entire run
All items, trinkets, stats and pickups collected are kept
The timer does not reset
description_zh:
整局重新开始
已收集的道具, 饰品, 属性和掉落物保留
计时器不重置
wiki_description: Returns Isaac back to the first floor of a new run, retaining all of his stats and items.

name: Knockout Drops
description_en:
10% chance to shoot a fist that inflicts confusion and extreme knockback
 100% chance at 9 luck
Enemies take damage when they get knocked into a wall/obstacle
description_zh:
10%概率发射拳头, 对敌人造成强力击退和混乱
 运气9: 100%概率
撞到墙/障碍物的敌人会受到伤害
wiki_description: Adds a chance to shoot a fist tear that has extremely high knockback and confuses enemies.

name: Eraser
description_en:
Throws an eraser that instantly kills an enemy
Prevents the erased enemy from spawning for the rest of the run
Deals 15 damage to bosses
Can only be used once per floor
description_zh:
掷出橡皮, 秒杀击中的敌人
击杀的敌人在本局游戏中不会再出现
对头目造成15点伤害
每层只能使用一次
wiki_description: Throws an eraser that instantly kills the first monster it hits, and prevents that enemy from spawning for the rest of the run. Deals 15 damage to bosses, erasing the boss from the rest of the run if damage is fatal. Only recharges upon entering a new floor.

name: Yuck Heart
description_en: +1 Rotten Heart
description_zh: +1腐心
wiki_description: Grants Isaac a Rotten Heart.

name: Urn of Souls
description_en:
Spews a stream of flames
Killing an enemy adds a charge to the urn
description_zh:
喷射火焰
击杀1个敌人, 瓮增加1格充能
wiki_description: Isaac pulls out or puts away an urn that fires a stream of damaging blue flames. It gains Soul Charges each time an enemy dies, which are used to fuel the urn.

name: Akeldama
description_en:
Creates a chain of tears behind Isaac in hostile rooms
The tears deal 3.5 damage
description_zh:
在有敌人的房间中, 在角色身后产生一串泪弹
泪弹造成3.5点伤害
wiki_description: While in an uncleared room, Isaac forms a trail of bloody tears that drags behind him, bursting and dealing damage upon contact with enemies.

name: Magic Skin
description_en:
Spawns an item from the current room's item pool
 Turns 1 heart container or 1 Bone Heart or 2 Soul Hearts into a Broken Heart
 Replaces future items if Isaac isn't holding it (33% after 1 use, 50% after 2, 100% after 3)
Lower chance if Magic Skin is on a pedestal on the current floor
description_zh:
生成当前房间道具池的1个道具
将1心之容器/1骨心/2魂心变为1碎心
生成当前房间道具池的1个道具
 若角色不再持有, 则有概率将后续道具替换(1次使用后33%, 2次后50%, 3次后100%)
若玄奇驴皮在本层道具底座上, 则降低概率
wiki_description: Consumes one heart container or two Soul Hearts to spawn an item and grant Isaac a broken heart container that can never be filled. If Magic Skin is not held after being used, it is very likely to replace any future items.

name: Revelation
description_en:
Flight
 Chargeable high damage holy beam
Does not replace Isaac's tears
description_zh:
飞行
 可蓄力发射高伤害圣光柱
不会取代角色的泪弹
wiki_description: Grants flight. In addition to tears, Isaac can charge up and fire a powerful holy laser. Category:Modified in AfterbirthCategory:Modified in Repentance+ Also grants two Soul Hearts.

name: Consolation Prize
description_en:
Increases Isaac's lowest stat out of Speed, Fire rate, Damage, and Range
Spawns either 3 coins, 1 bomb, or 1 key depending on what Isaac has the least of
description_zh:
提升角色移速/射速/伤害/射程中最低的属性
根据角色持有的最少掉落物, 生成3硬币/1炸弹/1钥匙
wiki_description: Increases Isaac's lowest stat and drops either 3 Coins, 1 Bomb, or 1 Key depending on what Isaac has the least of.

name: Tinytoma
description_en:
Large orbital that blocks shots
Deals 3.5 contact damage per second
Splits into smaller versions of itself upon taking 3 hits
The smaller versions break into blue spiders
Respawns 5 seconds after fully disappearing
description_zh:
阻挡弹幕的大型环绕物
每秒造成3.5点接触伤害
受击3次时, 分裂为更小的畸胎瘤
小畸胎瘤被摧毁时产生蓝蜘蛛
被完全摧毁时, 5秒后重生
wiki_description: Gives Isaac a Teratoma orbital that blocks shots, deals contact damage, and splits into smaller versions of itself upon taking damage. The smaller versions break into blue spiders.

name: Brimstone Bombs
description_en:
+5 Bombs
 Isaac's bombs release a 4-way blood beam
The beams don't hurt Isaac
description_zh:
+5炸弹
 角色的炸弹爆炸时, 释放十字血柱
血柱不会伤到角色
wiki_description: +5 Bombs. Bombs fire four Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions upon exploding.

name: 4.5 Volt
quote: Beat the juice out of them!
description_en:
Clearing rooms no longer charges active items
Dealing damage to enemies slowly fills up the charge bar
Damage needed per charge increases each floor
description_zh:
清理房间不再对主动道具充能
对敌人造成伤害时缓慢充能
充能所需伤害量随层数提升
wiki_description: Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Instead, they're charged by dealing damage to enemies.

name: Fruity Plum
description_en:
